problem: The constraint compares the quantity unit against qudt:UNITLESS, which expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/UNITLESS, but the canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS. Consequently, correctly unitless quantities fail and the noncanonical schema-namespace unit may pass.
required_change: Replace every qudt:UNITLESS unit reference with http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS, preferably by declaring a separate unit vocabulary prefix.
regression_guard: Preserve the canonical QUDT unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS for all sea-ice-concentration checks.
